id.description: ID of the order. This property is always present in responses.

status.description: Status of the order. This property is always present in responses.

email.description: Email of the orderer. This property is always present in responses.

totalPrice.description: Total price of the order. This property is always present in responses.

registrationToken.description: Optional registration token. If this order is `PENDING_UITID_CONNECT` this field is present to allow for easy UiTiD account linking.

customToken.description: Custom token that can be used for a limited number of time to request this order using `GET /orders/id` without any further authentication.

extraPassholderRegistrations.description: Optional list of extra passholders in the order

redirectUrlAfterPayment.description: Where to redirect after payment. Extra query params `orderId` and `customToken` are added to this URL when used to redirect the user, so the receiving client can `GET` the latest status of the order.

redirectUrlAfterCancelPayment.description: Where to redirect after payment is cancelled. Extra query params `orderId` and `customToken` are added to this URL when used to redirect the user, so the receiving client can `GET` the latest status of the order.

CardSystem.title: CardSystem
CardSystem.description: A region, usually one or multiple municipalities in Belgium, that uses UiTPAS and provides discounts and/or rewards. For example "Paspartoe" (Brussels), UiTPAS Leuven, UiTPAS Hasselt, UiTPAS Gent, and so on.

name.description: Name of the card system. This field is always available in responses.

branding.description: Branding information of the card system

logo.description: URL to the logo of the card system

primaryColor.description: Color code of the primary branding color.

secondaryColor.description: Color code of the secondary branding color.

website.description: URL of the website of the card system

cities.description: List of cities that are part of this card system

permanent.description: Indicates whether this is a permanent card system

allowsCardlessRegistration.description: Indicates if cardless registration is enabled

cardlessRegistrationType.description: Indicates the types of online cardless registrations this cardsystem supports.

socialTariffInfo.description: Optional information about social tariff entitlement in this card system.

Organizer.title: Organizer
Organizer.description: An organisation that partners with UiTPAS to provide discounts and/or rewards, and/or allows points to be collected at their events.

id.description: Unique ID of an UiTPAS organizer. (Same as its ID in UiTdatabank)

name.description: Human-readable name of an UiTPAS organizer.

cardSystems.description: Card systems linked to this organizer

linkedLocationId.description: ID of the location linked to this organizer.

address.description: Address of this organizer. This property is alway available in responses.

PassholderRegistration.title: PassholderRegistration
PassholderRegistration.description:
Registration request of a passholder, mainly used in the online order flow.

A `PassholderRegistration` is not yet `Passholder` but one can be created (e.g. when the order is paid) using the information from the `PassholderRegistration`.

id.description: ID of the PassholderRegistation. **Note:** This is not same as the later `Passholder` id. This field is always available in responses.

name.description: Last name of the passholder to register.

firstName.description: First name of the passholder to register.

inszNumber.description: Unique national (Belgian) INSZ number of an individual passholder.

email.description: Contact email address of the passholder to register

creationDate.description: This field is always available in responses.

dateOfBirth.description: Date that the passholder to register was born.

gender.description: Gender of the passholder to register.

address.description: Address that the passholder to register lives at. Always present in responses. Passholders living outside of Belgium (usually near the border) will only have a `postalCode` and `city` in their address.

street.description: Street name, number and optional box number of the address.

number.description: House number. This field is deprecated and will be empty. The house number is part of the `street` property.

box.description: Postal box number. This field is deprecated and will be empty. The box number is part of the `street` property.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number of the passholder to register, for example for SMS alerts.

optInPreferences.description: Permissions that the passholder has given to be contacted.

serviceMails.description: Important information about the functionality of UiTPAS.

milestoneMails.description: Notification when you reach an important UiTPAS milestone, for example a specific amount of points or an exclusive reward becomes available to you.

infoMails.description: Rewards, actions and events selected specifically for the passholder based on their UiTPAS history.

sms.description: Free (sporadic) SMS messages with rewards, actions and events selected specifically for the passholder based on their UiTPAS history.

post.description: Sporadic post mail with information about UiTPAS. Will be sent to the passholder's postal address.

parentalConsent.description: Set to true for under-aged passholder that have parental consent.

legalTermsPaper.description: Set to true for passholders that received legal terms on paper.

legalTermsDigital.description: Set to true for passholders that received legal terms digitally.

registrationCardSystemId.description: Set to the id of the card system of which the passholder has to become a member.

requested.description: `true` if social tariff is requested for this registration. Always available in responses if `registrationSocialTariff` exists.

idToken.description: The Social Tariff Validation ID token of the user. Use the [social tariff validation flow](/reference/uitpas.json/paths/~1social-tariff-validation~1start/get) to obtain such ID tokens. If specified, this token must be valid, contain `hasSocialTariff:true` and the identity fields must match the fields in this registration. In all other cases an error is returned.
